# NEW 2026-11-23 v18.0 Module 18.0-B: Living Estates, Private Regiments, Real Banking Estate Loans & Building-Country Logistics Overhaul (oe_est2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_living_estates_banks.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot O(1) yearly dispatcher exported for oe_gk_yearly_dispatch (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_est2_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_est2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_est2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_est2_ran_y value = current_year }
		oe_est2_building_country_guard_yearly = yes
		oe_est2_dispatch_hosts_yearly = yes
	}
}

# Global scope. O(1) targeted anti-starvation & logistics guard for major 1337 building-based
# banking/league countries (HSA, PRZ, BRD, ACC, OBY + dynamically spawned banks) and active
# Japanese Shogunate building-based daimyo (capped rolling sweep of up to 18 clans/year).
oe_est2_building_country_guard_yearly = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HSA } c:HSA = { oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PRZ } c:PRZ = { oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BRD } c:BRD = { oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ACC } c:ACC = { oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OBY } c:OBY = { oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes } }

	# Lightweight capped sweep for dynamically formed banking_country tags (e.g., Fuggers / Welsers).
	ordered_country_of_country_type = {
		type = building
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_reform = government_reform:banking_country
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_building_logistics_shield }
		}
		order_by = total_population
		max = 8
		check_range_bounds = no
		oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = yes
	}

	# Capped rolling guard for Japanese Shogunate building-based daimyo (18/year with 5-year shield = 0 lag).
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate }
		ordered_country_of_country_type = {
			type = building
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_shugo_rice_stipend }
			}
			order_by = total_population
			max = 18
			check_range_bounds = no
			oe_est2_guard_single_shugo_daimyo = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Keeps a building-based banking house or maritime league solvent and supplied.
oe_est2_guard_single_bank_league = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			country_type = building
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_est2_mod_building_logistics_shield
			years = 3
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					gold < 60
					is_during_bankruptcy = yes
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_bank_bailout_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_bank_bailout_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			add_gold = 85
			distribute_gold_to_banking_estates = 40
			if = {
				limit = { is_during_bankruptcy = yes }
				set_bankruptcy = no
				add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Supplies a building-based Japanese Shogunate daimyo clan with koku rice logistics.
oe_est2_guard_single_shugo_daimyo = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			country_type = building
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_est2_mod_shugo_rice_stipend
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold < 30
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_shugo_stipend_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_shugo_stipend_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			add_gold = 40
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Mobilizes one verified private regiment for a restless armed estate (capped at 4).
oe_est2_mobilize_estate_regiment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			NOT = {
				any_estate = {
					estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate
					estate_unraised_regiment_count >= 4
				}
			}
		}
		add_estate_private_regiment = {
			estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			unit_type = unit_type:a_horsemen
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_est2_private_levies_active value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = estate_type:tribes_estate value < 0.35 }
				stability < 0
			}
			NOT = {
				any_estate = {
					estate_type = estate_type:tribes_estate
					estate_unraised_regiment_count >= 4
				}
			}
		}
		add_estate_private_regiment = {
			estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
			unit_type = unit_type:a_horsemen
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_est2_private_levies_active value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = estate_type:cossacks_estate value < 0.35 }
				stability < 0
			}
			NOT = {
				any_estate = {
					estate_type = estate_type:cossacks_estate
					estate_unraised_regiment_count >= 4
				}
			}
		}
		add_estate_private_regiment = {
			estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate
			unit_type = unit_type:a_horsemen
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_est2_private_levies_active value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Dissolves all unraised estate private regiments ("Cup of Wine Disarmament").
oe_est2_disarm_estate_regiments = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		clear_estate_private_regiments = { estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate }
		clear_estate_private_regiments = { estate = estate_type:tribes_estate }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate }
		clear_estate_private_regiments = { estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_est2_private_levies_active }
		remove_variable = oe_est2_private_levies_active
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_est2_disarmed_y value = current_year }
}

# Country scope. Real banking estate loan & liquidity injection into banking/burgher estates.
oe_est2_charter_estate_credit = {
	create_estate_loan = {
		amount = {
			value = {
				add = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
				multiply = 6
				min = 40
				max = 4000
			}
		}
		interest = 0.035
		months = 60
	}
	distribute_gold_to_banking_estates = 40
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		add_gold_to_estate = {
			estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate
			value = 30
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Yearly living estates & banking event dispatcher over bounded host set.
oe_est2_dispatch_hosts_yearly = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			oe_est2_is_living_estates_host = yes
		}
		oe_est2_country_yearly = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Yearly private regiment pressure check & 16-event chronological/dynamic dispatcher.
oe_est2_country_yearly = {
	# Smooth Sengoku territorial transition buff if a Shogunate member now holds landed provinces.
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_est2_is_japan_region = yes
			country_type = location
			current_year >= 1465
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_sengoku_koku_transition }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_sengoku_trans_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_est2_sengoku_trans_done value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_est2_mod_sengoku_koku_transition
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Living Estate Private Regiment background muster during acute estate dissatisfaction or crisis.
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_type = location
			oe_est2_has_restless_armed_estate = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_levy_muster_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_est2_levy_muster_cd value = 1 years = 6 }
		oe_est2_mobilize_estate_regiment = yes
	}

	# Event dispatch (18-month per-country cooldown + global flavor throttle; blocks Act I/II ELR isolation).
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_cd }
		}

		# .1 Magnate Private Banners Mustered
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_1_done }
				country_type = location
				country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				num_locations >= 25
				oe_years_since_start >= 15
				OR = {
					oe_est2_has_restless_armed_estate = yes
					current_year >= 1348
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_1_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.1
		}
		# .2 Sengoku Shugo & Samurai Retainer Standoff
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_2_done }
				oe_est2_is_japan_region = yes
				current_year >= 1360
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_2_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.2
		}
		# .3 Boyar Druzhina & Cossack Frontier Host
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_3_done }
				oe_est2_is_russia_region = yes
				current_year >= 1378
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_3_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.3
		}
		# .4 Mamluk & Qizilbash Warlord Demarche
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_4_done }
				current_year >= 1395
				OR = {
					tag = MAM
					oe_est2_is_ottoman_region = yes
					oe_est2_is_persia_region = yes
					oe_est2_is_india_region = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_4_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.4
		}
		# .5 The Cup of Wine Disarmament Banquet
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_5_done }
				country_type = location
				num_locations >= 25
				oe_years_since_start >= 15
				stability >= 8
				OR = {
					has_variable = oe_est2_private_levies_active
					oe_est2_has_any_private_regiments = yes
					current_year >= 1420
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_5_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.5
		}
		# .6 Florentine Houses of Peruzzi, Bardi & Acciaioli
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_6_done }
				current_year >= 1339
				OR = {
					oe_est2_is_west_central_europe = yes
					tag = BYZ
					tag = OBY
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_6_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.6
		}
		# .7 The Medici Bills of Exchange
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_7_done }
				current_year >= 1408
				OR = {
					oe_est2_is_west_central_europe = yes
					tag = BYZ
					tag = OBY
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_7_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.7
		}
		# .8 The Fugger Imperial Credit & Silver Mines
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_8_done }
				current_year >= 1455
				oe_est2_is_west_central_europe = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_8_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.8
		}
		# .9 Shanxi Piaohao & Phanariot Banking Syndicates
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_9_done }
				current_year >= 1475
				OR = {
					oe_est2_is_yuan_realm = yes
					oe_est2_is_ming_han_realm = yes
					oe_est2_is_qing_manchu_realm = yes
					oe_est2_is_ottoman_region = yes
					oe_est2_is_persia_region = yes
					oe_est2_is_india_region = yes
					tag = BYZ
					tag = MAM
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_9_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.9
		}
		# .10 Sovereign Debt Default & Clearing-House Panic
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_10_done }
				oe_years_since_start >= 15
				OR = {
					num_loans >= 3
					is_during_bankruptcy = yes
					inflation >= 0.08
					current_year >= 1505
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_10_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.10
		}
		# .11 Banking Bailout or Vault Seizure
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_11_done }
				oe_years_since_start >= 15
				OR = {
					has_variable = oe_est2_ev_10_done
					current_year >= 1530
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_11_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.11
		}
		# .12 Hanseatic Kontor Charter & Baltic Staple
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_12_done }
				current_year >= 1346
				OR = {
					tag = HSA tag = LUB tag = HAM tag = BRE tag = DAN tag = SWE
					tag = ENG tag = HOL tag = NED tag = POL tag = BRA tag = NOV
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_12_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.12
		}
		# .13 Maritime Merchant League & Banking Convoy
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_est2_ev_13_done }
				current_year >= 1388
				OR = {
					oe_est2_is_major_building_bank_or_league = yes
					tag = VEN tag = GEN tag = BYZ tag = HOL tag = NED tag = ENG tag = POR
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_13_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_est2.13

		# .14 Ashikaga Shugo-Daimyo Building-Clan Logistics
		else_if = {

		# .15 Koku Rice Stipends & Castle-Town Granaries
		else_if = {

				oe_est2_is_japan_region = yes

		# .16 From Building-Clan to Territorial Daimyo
